deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. It holds a short draft, in faint pencil and in German, of what appears to be a letter or reply by Riemann declining a request. My tentative reading: 'Um jedoch [?] ... auch um weitere Verhandlungen überflüssig zu machen, da man ... [Hochschul-/Universitäts]lehrern und [Privatdocenten, struck through and replaced by an illegible interlinear word] ... [ertheilten?] Auftrag übernehmen zu können wünschte, so [struck word] ich nur doch auch voraussetzen, dass es für mich neben meinen anderweitigen Verpflichtungen eine Unmöglichkeit ist, die gewünschte Prüfung in der kurzen Zeit bis zur [struck word, replaced by an interlinear word] auszuführen:'. In English: 'However, also to make further negotiations superfluous, since one wished to be able to entrust the commission to university teachers and [Privatdozenten] ..., I must assume that, alongside my other obligations, it is impossible for me to carry out the requested examination in the short time until ...'. The passage ends with a colon, so it introduces something that is not on this sheet. Below it is a short, largely illegible line, possibly an address, place or signature-like note, followed by the folio number 132. The rest of the sheet is blank. The context suggests Riemann was asked to carry out an examination (Prüfung), perhaps of a candidate or of a submitted work, at short notice and declined for lack of time. The previous page, with a Weber-type electrodynamic potential, velocity-dependent terms in 1/c^2 and an iterated-Laplacian equation, is unrelated to this draft.

results.what: Draft of a letter declining a requested examination/assessment (Prüfung) because of other obligations and the short deadline
